entities.name: Robert Lowth
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Robert Lowth was an English clergyman and academic who served as the Bishop of Oxford, Bishop of St Davids, Professor of Poetry and the author of one of the most influential 
textbooks of English grammar.
